diagnostics.details: A payload is bounded when every string has .maxLength(n) or .maxChars(n), every array .maxItems(n), and it holds no record (export name: chat).
diagnostics.message: Unreliable signal chat.bubble has no bound on its payload size; Roblox drops an unreliable payload over 900 bytes without an error.
diagnostics.name: unreliable-signal-payload-unbounded
diagnostics.suggestion: Bound the payload schema, or make the signal reliable.

diagnostics.details: Largest binary frame (2312 bytes, 4-byte header included) plus its wire frame (66 bytes) (export name: trail).
diagnostics.message: Unreliable signal fx.trail can carry up to 2378 bytes, over Roblox's 900-byte unreliable limit; larger payloads are dropped without an error.
diagnostics.name: unreliable-signal-payload-too-large
diagnostics.suggestion: Lower the payload's maxLength / maxItems bounds, split it, or make the signal reliable.

diagnostics.details: Largest binary frame (868 bytes, 4-byte header included) plus its wire frame (66 bytes) (export name: burst).
diagnostics.message: Unreliable signal fx.burst can carry up to 934 bytes, over Roblox's 900-byte unreliable limit; larger payloads are dropped without an error.
diagnostics.name: unreliable-signal-payload-too-large
diagnostics.suggestion: Lower the payload's maxLength / maxItems bounds, split it, or make the signal reliable.

diagnostics.details: Largest payload by the binary layout (620 bytes) plus its wire frame (65 bytes). The table encoding adds a type tag and key per value on top, which the compiler cannot size (export name: near).
diagnostics.message: Unreliable signal fx.near is at least 685 bytes with the table encoding, over 75% of Roblox's 900-byte unreliable limit; its real size is larger and may be over it.
diagnostics.name: unreliable-signal-payload-near-limit
diagnostics.suggestion: Set wire: "binary": its size is exact, and the publisher checks each frame against the limit before firing.
